gen-dafont-college-gf-mada: College draws like a pencil that never presses harder, every curve as heavy as its stems. Mada follows with a low, towering midzone and curves left open, friendly where the heading is blunt and commanding.
gen-dafont-college-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads with generous openings in every curve and a high mean line running across each word. And College above it, drawn in true monoline, gives that gentle text a firmer, more dynamic start.
gen-dafont-college-gf-matangi:
College is drawn in true monoline, with big counters in a tall lowercase.

Matangi softens that authority with strokes like pressed twine and rounded letters left open, so the pair feels both commanding and approachable.
gen-dafont-college-gf-michroma: Michroma reads with a wide berth around each letter and curves that leave daylight, like a rope's open bight. And College, drawn with a rounded-wire stroke, supplies the firm, dynamic voice that this spacious plain sans lacks.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: College has big counters in a tall lowercase and curves as thick as its straight stems, which gives it real authority. Mochiy Pop P One answers with wide spacing and a sizable, friendly lowercase.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-headline: College holds thin joins no thinner than its stems, so every headline letter comes out blunt and dynamic. Mozilla Headline relaxes into big-bodied lowercase with a splayed c terminal.
gen-dafont-college-gf-mozilla-text: Heavy bowls, tall bodies, zero hesitation. Mozilla Text carries the same boldness-looking lowercase, but its terminals flare outward, which loosens the stiffness College brings to the top.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nata-sans: College looks like it was drawn with a rod, every curve as heavy as its straight stems and its counters big. Nata Sans offsets that with wide, unclosed curves.
gen-dafont-college-gf-nobile: College feels like one constant pen width throughout, with big counters in a tall lowercase. Nobile steps in with open letter mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined, and the caps sit close to its x-height.
gen-dafont-college-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills most of its letter height with lowercase bodies, and its c stays wide open. A sizing hint: give College, with its rod-stock verticals and horizontals, plenty more size.
